content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Bellevue

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree—no prior project management work experience needed. You'll also need to complete a defined number of project management education contact hours. This makes CAPM ideal for career changers and early-career professionals entering Bellevue's competitive job market.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Our intensive format condenses the required contact hours into a focused learning experience, allowing you to earn your credential quickly while balancing work and life in the Seattle area.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your education hours, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the registration process to ensure your application meets all PMI requirements before you sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Take advantage of Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study strategies aligned to the CAPM test domains. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—help you build confidence and readiness for exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. Stay current by earning professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, and other PMI-recognized activities. Renew before expiration to keep your credential active and competitive in your local career market.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
